name: smart-entrance-exit-attendance-system
description: Integrated Smart Entrance, Exit, and Attendance Monitoring System with Data Analytics

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "SERVER,ELECTRON,FACE,API,ATTENDANCE" --prefix-colors "blue,green,yellow,red,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run client-electron" "npm run face-service" "npm run attendance-api" "npm run attendance-client"
scripts.dev-web: concurrently --kill-others --names "SERVER,WEB,FACE,API,ATTENDANCE" --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,yellow,red,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run client-web" "npm run face-service" "npm run attendance-api" "npm run attendance-client"
scripts.install-all: npm run install-backend && npm run install-client && npm run install-attendance
scripts.python-setup: cd module1/python && pip install fastapi uvicorn opencv-python numpy mediapipe
scripts.status: echo '=== System Status ===' && echo 'Backend: http://localhost:3000' && echo 'Electron/Web: http://localhost:5173' && echo 'Face Service: http://localhost:5000' && echo 'Attendance API: http://localhost:8000'
